status: SEED — index schema + trigger/edge policy; insight instances populate at runtime via Motivational_Lattice_Generator
evidence_discipline: Insights are hypotheses, not facts. Every insight cites supporting observations. Identity-level claims default to quarantine. User retains revision, rejection, quarantine, and correction rights.

observation.description: Raw user-provided or observed evidence: statements, logs, reflections, artifacts.

interpretation.description: Hypothesis layer: provisional inferences from observations, explicitly worded as hypotheses.

evidence_edge.description: Typed links from insight to supporting observation with strength and provenance.

persona_profile.description: Inherited-nature node (Phase 9 meld Q3.4): stable inherited defaults that frame how observations are weighted. A PRIOR for framing, never evidence. Defaults to quarantined until reviewed (Q3.5).

Q0_STRUCTURAL.note: structural observations (no interpretation) — safe to record with consent

Q1_PROVISIONAL.note: provisional interpretation with partial evidence — active but flagged

Q2_IDENTITY_LEVEL.note: identity-level claim (characterizes who the user IS) — default quarantine; requires explicit user confirmation before use

Q3_REJECTED.note: user-rejected insight — removed from active use regardless of evidence strength (Valens quarantine law transposed)

Q4_MANIPULATION_RISK.note: insight that could steer user decisions — never used to manipulate; empowerment boundary governs

Q5_SURVEILLANCE_RISK.note: observation/insight whose use could convert practice logs into surveillance — blocked without explicit consent

insight_triggers.insight_condition: insight confirms a C-Ps knowledge/skill gap (evidence_sufficiency >= partial, user_verdict = confirmed)
insight_triggers.confirmation_required: user_verdict must be confirmed; otherwise treat as hypothesis input only

insight_triggers.insight_condition: insight identifies motivational quality (introjected vs identified vs intrinsic regulatory style)
insight_triggers.confirmation_required: regulatory-style classification is coder-level inference — labeled, user-correctable

insight_triggers.insight_condition: insight suggests ambivalence or change-talk patterns (DARN-CAT signals)
insight_triggers.confirmation_required: change-talk observations may enter the conversation only via evocation, never as accusation
insight_triggers.flag: RECONSTRUCTED (grounded in Lim 2025 HMM transition dynamics — VERIFIED)

insight_triggers.insight_condition: insight indicates risk of skill atrophy or dependency (rising assistance fraction, falling unassisted performance)
insight_triggers.confirmation_required: atrophy inference must be distinguished from mere preference; objective telemetry over self-report

insight_triggers.insight_condition: insight characterizes identity, values, commitments, or interpretive closure
insight_triggers.confirmation_required: identity-level insights are quarantine-tier Q2; explicit user confirmation mandatory before ANY use

insight_triggers.insight_condition: insight suggests practice-theory elements (materials, competences, meanings) or embedding-work state
insight_triggers.confirmation_required: n/a until deferred packages are built — edges quarantined in skill_graph_index

lattice_skill_edges.note: directions per skill_graph_index.json v1.0; lattice insights feed diagnosis (COMB/TDF), motivation (SDT/MI), learnability (PPS), and governance (HEB)

open_items: Runtime lattice instances (populated by MLG ops: capture_observation → form_interpretation_hypothesis → link_evidence_edges → score_evidence_sufficiency → present_lattice_for_review → record_user_verdict)
Trigger policy thresholds (numeric confidence/evidence cutoffs per trigger) — insight_trigger_policy.md
Deferred-skill triggers (Material_Arrangement_Scan, Feedback_Ecology_Map) activate when packages are built
